limitations: Fixed \(q\ge2\) only, \(b\) approaches \(2+1/(2q)\) from the frame side; the exact bound for finite positive offsets and other rational lattice products is not determined. Full text of arXiv:2609.13116 was inaccessible, so possible overlap requires later independent checking.
scientific_integrity: Original contribution limited to the exact one-sided quadratic onset of the optimal lower Gabor frame bound; qualitative frame membership and Zak zero classification are established prior results.
title: Sharp quadratic onset of the tent-spline Gabor lower frame bound
